about: The host's schedule posts three stage lineups with 20 minute slots from 5 PM onward. Acts include the Liberty Elementary Chorus, the First United Methodist Church Choir, Hip Hop Kidz, the St. Anthony School Choir and the Pine Crest School Jazz Band.
Snow Mountain tickets have their own booth on the vendor map, and the host also lists Elf Pubs along 6th, 8th and 9th Avenues serving holiday refreshments.
Santa's Village and the Good Times Roll Bus are the two photo stops the host recommends for family pictures. Vendors and sponsors run raffles and giveaways through the night.

about: Whimsical Wonderland is one night of a three night Holiday Magic fundraiser at Bonnet House. The host lists Concerts on the Veranda on December 3 and 10 and the family evening on December 5.
Inside the historic house, illuminated trees, wreaths and centerpieces are on display, and they are for sale through Sunday, December 27. The host says 100 percent of proceeds go to Bonnet House.
The arts calendar lists a phone number for questions, (954) 563-5393, and says tickets and reservations are handled through the Bonnet House site.
